notes: Core totalBoughtEur includes multiple purchases and may be financed by proceeds; its ratio to initial capital is NOT a time-varying allocation.
Missing free cash does not prove that funds cannot be redeployed; selling or transferring creates economic turnover, fee and tax consequences.
NO new replay or intervention, no causal attribution of underperformance.
The input replay sample is consumed for design; never use it to promote a policy or tune weights.

methodologicalInsight: Subtracting the same benchmark return from every asset in a given same-date same-horizon cross section does not change ranking order. A core-relative signal must introduce a testable decision hurdle, time-consistency, valuation/fundamental evidence, or risk adjustment rather than a renamed ranking.
